text: APPROVE. The extracted helpers move the code over unchanged, and the lazy `Where(reported.Add(...))` after `DistinctBy` dedups in the same order as the old `if (!reported.Add) continue`. Moving the two loops and the site construction out removes roughly 18 points of nesting-weighted complexity, which should bring the method from 29 to about 11. I couldn't build it here, so the new helper signatures (`CiChangeFilter`, `TestInvocation`, `JsInventory.Inventory`, `List<string> missed`) are unchecked against the real types.
